attributes.storage_note: 1. Store it in a cool & dry place, avoid direct sun exposure. 2. If any discomfort or allergic symptom occurs, discontinue use. 3. For external use only. 4. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact with eyes, rinse immediately with water. 5. Keep out of reach of Children. 6. Perform patch test before use.
